title: Constraint: Non-Overlapping Memory Accesses
constraints: Six memory accesses `[addr[i], addr[i] + len[i])` with 1 … 8 bytes each, all inside a 64-byte buffer, and **no two overlapping**.
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Two ranges don't overlap if one ends before the other starts.
Widen before adding (`int'(addr[i]) + len[i]`): 6-bit + 4-bit arithmetic would wrap at 64.
